query:
WITH b AS (
  -- saldo s/d tanggal laporan ('ini') dan s/d tanggal yang sama tahun lalu ('lalu': tanggal jurnal digeser +1 tahun)
  SELECT G1.part AS periode, G1.d, G1.account_id, G1.dk
  FROM (
    SELECT 'ini'::text AS part, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.tanggal::date AS dm, jv.account_id, jv.department_id, jv.project_id, jv.cost_code_id,
           COALESCE(jv.debit,0)::numeric - COALESCE(jv.kredit,0)::numeric AS dk
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id JOIN kiraan k0 ON k0.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'lalu'::text AS part, (g.tanggal + interval '1 year')::date AS d, (g.tanggal + interval '1 year')::date AS dm, jv.account_id, jv.department_id, jv.project_id, jv.cost_code_id,
           COALESCE(jv.debit,0)::numeric - COALESCE(jv.kredit,0)::numeric AS dk
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id JOIN kiraan k0 ON k0.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
akun AS (
  SELECT k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama, kl.noklasifikasi AS kls,
         COALESCE(sk.namasubklasifikasi, '(Tanpa subklasifikasi)') AS pos, COALESCE(sk.nosubklasifikasi, 0) AS pos_urut,
         CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(sk.namasubklasifikasi,'') || ' ' || k.nama) ~ '(tetap|penyusutan|amortisasi|tak berwujud|tidak berwujud|goodwill|properti investasi|investasi jangka panjang|jangka panjang|aset lain|aktiva lain|pajak tangguhan|hak guna|right of use|entitas asosiasi)' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
              WHEN kl.noklasifikasi = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(sk.namasubklasifikasi,'') || ' ' || k.nama) ~ '(jangka panjang|imbalan pasca|imbalan kerja|pesangon|obligasi|pajak tangguhan|liabilitas sewa|sewa pembiayaan)' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
              ELSE 1 END AS sub_urut,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'ini'  THEN b.dk ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dk_ini,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'lalu' THEN b.dk ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dk_lalu
  FROM kiraan  k                                   -- semua akun neraca ikut, termasuk saldo 0 (disaring di tampilan)
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.account_id = k.id
  WHERE kl.noklasifikasi <= 3
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
),
thn AS (SELECT periode, MAX(d) AS maxd FROM b GROUP BY periode),
laba AS (
  -- laba rugi kumulatif masuk ekuitas: tahun berjalan (tahun dari tanggal transaksi terakhir s/d tanggal laporan) dan tahun-tahun sebelumnya
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'ini'  AND date_part('year', b.d) =  date_part('year', t.maxd) THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS berjalan_ini,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'lalu' AND date_part('year', b.d) =  date_part('year', t.maxd) THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS berjalan_lalu,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'ini'  AND date_part('year', b.d) <> date_part('year', t.maxd) THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS ditahan_ini,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.periode = 'lalu' AND date_part('year', b.d) <> date_part('year', t.maxd) THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS ditahan_lalu
  FROM b
  JOIN thn     t  ON t.periode = b.periode
  JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = b.account_id
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  WHERE kl.noklasifikasi >= 4
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT kls AS kelompok_urut,
         CASE kls WHEN 1 THEN 'ASET' WHEN 2 THEN 'LIABILITAS' ELSE 'EKUITAS' END AS kelompok,
         sub_urut,
         CASE WHEN kls = 1 AND sub_urut = 1 THEN 'Aset lancar' WHEN kls = 1 THEN 'Aset tidak lancar'
              WHEN kls = 2 AND sub_urut = 1 THEN 'Liabilitas jangka pendek' WHEN kls = 2 THEN 'Liabilitas jangka panjang'
              ELSE 'Ekuitas' END AS sub,
         pos_urut, pos, akun_kode, akun_nama,
         (CASE WHEN kls = 1 THEN dk_ini  ELSE -dk_ini  END)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai_ini,
         (CASE WHEN kls = 1 THEN dk_lalu ELSE -dk_lalu END)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai_lalu
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'EKUITAS', 1, 'Ekuitas', 999999999, 'Saldo laba', '', 'Saldo laba tahun-tahun sebelumnya', COALESCE(ditahan_ini,0)::numeric(18,2), COALESCE(ditahan_lalu,0)::numeric(18,2) FROM laba
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'EKUITAS', 1, 'Ekuitas', 999999999, 'Saldo laba', '', 'Laba (rugi) tahun berjalan', COALESCE(berjalan_ini,0)::numeric(18,2), COALESCE(berjalan_lalu,0)::numeric(18,2) FROM laba
)
SELECT * FROM hasil
ORDER BY kelompok_urut, sub_urut, pos_urut, pos, akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
